t: Easy to use, M35 HSS bit set containing fully-ground, high speed steel drill bits. Features 135° split point for precision drilling and forged tip for greater impact resistance and a longer lifetime. Specially designed for use with impact drivers and compatible with most drill drivers. For high performance applications. Supplied with universal magnetic holder for fast bit changes and a hard case for secured storage and organisation.
b: Contents: 11 Drill Bits, 91 Torsion Screwdriver Bits, 12 Hex, 5 Nutdrivers & Magnetic Bit Holder.
Suitable For Use with 3-Jaw Chuck Machines on Rotary Action
Suitable for Alloyed & Non-Alloyed Steel, Stainless Steel, Acid & Heat-Resistant Steels, Cast Iron & Cast Steel
